text:
rachel: deploy-bot initiating staged rollout v3.5.0 -> 3% (priority routes: autocomplete, code-gen). change window 01:00-03:00 UTC. warmup=gradual. watching p50/p95/p99, 5xx, and mem.

deploy-bot: [START] staged rollout id=deploy-8629991234 target=3% version=v3.5.0 routes=[autocomplete, code-gen] warmup=gradual

tom: quick heads-up: running a smoke test on code-gen, small spike in tokenization time in us-west2 (~+40ms). not yet > alert.

ops-sre: setting temporary auto-pause: p99>420ms OR 5xx>0.3% sustained 2m -> pause. keep an eye on host eviction.

emily: bump schedule set to 3% -> 15% in 12m. please thumbs up to proceed.

rachel: leaving it on auto for now. will pause if ops-sre gates trip.

deploy-bot: scheduled bump to 15% in 12m. react with :ok_hand: to proceed, :no_entry_sign: to cancel.

priya: :ok_hand: but flagging cold-starts on code-gen path in eu-west.

tom: actually just saw a 502 cascade from model-host-12 in eu-west about 3m ago. unclear if correlated.

ops-sre: investigating model-host-12. cpu and mem look normal; eviction-rate high. pulling k8s logs.

rachel: pausing bump preemptively. @deploy-bot pause rollout reason="eu-west model-host-12 eviction causing 502s"

deploy-bot: [PAUSE] Rollout paused at 3% by rachel. Reason="eu-west model-host-12 eviction causing 502s". Options: pin-region, per-route fallback, or rollback.

ops-sre: recommendation: apply per-route fallback for `code-gen` in eu-west -> v3.4.8 and cordon model-host-12 for drain. do not full rollback yet.

priya: agree, code-gen is the noisy route. autocomplete ok.

tom: routing patch ready. pushing now.

deploy-bot: applied routing override: code-gen.eu-west -> v3.4.8. propagation ~15s.

emily: code-gen p99 in eu-west dropped 800ms -> 240ms after override. 5xx cleared.

ops-sre: model-host-12 drained ~70%, eviction-rate down. leaving it cordoned for 1hr to rebuild cache.

rachel: quick poll: resume bump to 15% after 10m observation window? thumbs?

priya: :thumbsup: observe 10m then gradual 15%->30% if stable

tom: :thumbsup: prefer incremental 10% then 15%

emily: :thumbsup: monitor kvcache metrics closely

deploy-bot: scheduling incremental bump to 10% in 10m. Reply with :no_entry_sign: to cancel.

ops-sre: follow-up actions: add region-aware warmup caps and a short-circuit in warmup controller for high eviction rates. filing infra PR now.

rachel: updating release notes: "Staged rollout v3.5.0 paused briefly due to regional eviction on model-host-12; applied per-route fallback for code-gen in eu-west and cordoned host. Resuming incremental rollout." Will keep thread for postmortem and changelog.
